facts.fact: Le Matin says DGSSI launched maturity studies of banking, transport and energy under Morocco's national cybersecurity strategy to 2030.
DGSSI published a 'critical' alert on Thursday 12 November 2026 about attacks on ConnectWise ScreenConnect users.
Minister Loudyi said a DGSSI study of critical-importance infrastructures found compliance with national requirements above average, with individual reports sent to each institution.
DGSSI's watch centre recorded 1,070 security alerts, 81 high-risk, and flagged 2,154 threats to administrations, public bodies and critical infrastructures, in 2026.
